name: Computational Methods for Aerospace Engineers
summary: Programming and numerical methods (Python or MATLAB) used daily in aerospace analysis: from integrating trajectories to solving linear systems.

topics.name: Scientific programming in Python/MATLAB: arrays, plotting, vectorisation
Floating-point arithmetic, round-off and truncation error
Root finding: bisection, Newton-Raphson, secant (e.g. Kepler's equation)
Solving linear systems: LU decomposition, conditioning
Interpolation, curve fitting and least squares
ODE integrators: Euler, Runge-Kutta, adaptive step size, stiffness
Trajectory simulation: integrating equations of motion
Introduction to finite differences for PDEs
Optimisation basics: gradient methods and constrained problems
Monte Carlo simulation and uncertainty propagation
